step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture illustrates Vidsy's mobile-first video platform. User traffic comes in through a Public ALB which routes to Public ECS running Go APIs. Public ECS connects to an internal Private ALB that routes microservice traffic inside the VPC to Private ECS containers. Private ECS communicates with RDS for relational data and DynamoDB for non-relational payments/user data with DAX acceleration. S3 stores uploaded creator video assets, connected directly from Public ECS. Elastic Transcoder processes S3 assets into multiple bitrates and thumbnails. Route 53 provides private DNS resolution for internal ALB endpoints. All services and connections are transcribed directly from visual presentation and verbal explanations without extra unmentioned infrastructure.

edges.notes: User interacts with portal SPA sending requests to Public ALB.
Public ALB routes traffic to public Go APIs in Public ECS.
Public APIs invoke private internal APIs via Private ALB.
Private ALB routes internal requests to Private ECS containers.
Private services read and write relational data in RDS.
Payments API queries and persists payment data in DynamoDB.
Public API facilitates direct asset uploads and path creation to S3.
Uploaded video assets are transcoded into multiple bitrates and thumbnails by Elastic Transcoder.
Private Route 53 resolves private ALB DNS names for VPC internal routing.
